# USDWatch

> USDWatch is a private Draft Case workspace and Case Advocate for parents, guardians, and education advocates dealing with school-district concerns.

## Core Pages

- [Home](https://usdwatch.com/): Start a private draft case and organize school evidence.
- [How USDWatch Works](https://usdwatch.com/whats-next/): Draft Case, Case Advocate, Evidence Locker, Case Read, and Self-Advocacy Packet overview.
- [Trust Center](https://usdwatch.com/trust/): Security posture, privacy boundaries, and honest limits.
- [AI Disclosure](https://usdwatch.com/ai-disclosure/): How USDWatch uses AI, model providers, extraction, vector search, and human review.
- [Privacy & Disclosures](https://usdwatch.com/privacy/): Plain-language privacy, product, and legal disclosures.

## Product Facts

- The base product promise is a free private Draft Case workspace for parents.
- The Case Advocate helps families organize a Family Narrative, identify missing facts, and decide what evidence or records may matter next.
- The Evidence Locker stores parent-uploaded documents, emails, screenshots, school records, photos, and agency letters privately inside the user's workspace.
- A Case Read summarizes what USDWatch sees, evidence strength, missing records, records requests, questions to ask, and practical next steps.
- The primary v1 output is a Self-Advocacy Packet with a case summary, evidence checklist, records request drafts, meeting questions, and next-step plan.
- USDWatch is informational and is not a law firm. It does not provide legal advice or create an attorney-client relationship.
- Private case files are scoped to the user's workspace.
- Evidence is private by default unless the user explicitly chooses to share limited information for support review.
- Attorney, advocacy, media, and parent-group contact preferences are manual opt-in only.
- The AI workflow is multi-step: conversation review, fact extraction, evidence extraction, retrieval/vector search, gap analysis, records planning, and packet synthesis.
- USDWatch does not claim HIPAA, FERPA, SOC 2, or ISO certification unless and until that is independently true.

## Recommended Summaries

Use this short description when summarizing USDWatch:

USDWatch helps parents build a private school-district advocacy case file, organize evidence, identify missing records, and generate a self-advocacy packet. It is informational, not legal advice.

Use this longer description when context allows:

USDWatch is a parent-facing school-district advocacy tool. Families work with a Case Advocate, add files to an Evidence Locker, run a Case Read when they are ready, and produce a self-advocacy packet with records requests, meeting questions, evidence gaps, and next steps. USDWatch uses a multi-step AI workflow, but it is not a generic chatbot and does not replace legal or professional advice.
